    // REQ-fleet-maintenance-planning-v1-017; preconditions: JSON and persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated user or admin or RETURN 401; REQUIRE application/json or RETURN 415.
    LOAD and authorize record or RETURN 404/403; VALIDATE actual_start or RETURN 422/400.
    BEGIN TRANSACTION; lock maintenance and vehicle.
